metadataRaw.title: Fix Lower Back Pain FOR GOOD: 5 Safe Core Exercises
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows 5 safe core exercises designed to help fix lower back pain and provide long-lasting relief.

Each exercise works differently by strengthening important core and lower back muscles, and will be demonstrated in different positions.

For the best results, go through all 5 exercises and use the ones that feel best and give you the most relief.
